note: PLACEHOLDER CARDS for the UI; the real catalogue comes with the upgrade milestone.
numbers: Every cost and tier here is game balance, not a NASA figure.

cards.title: Bigger oxygen maker
cards.effect: Makes more oxygen from water each sol, but uses more electricity.
cards.question: How can a colony make the air it breathes?

cards.title: Health scanner
cards.effect: Shows how each crew member is doing before they feel ill.
cards.question: What does living on Mars do to the body?

cards.title: Brighter grow lights
cards.effect: Plants grow more food each sol, but the lights use more electricity.
cards.question: How much light do plants need to grow?

cards.title: More plant racks
cards.effect: Room for more plants, so the greenhouse makes more meals.
cards.question: Which plants give the most food for the space they take?

cards.title: Parts printer
cards.effect: Turns broken parts and scrap into new spare parts.
cards.question: What can we make from things we already have?

cards.title: Extra battery bank
cards.effect: Stores more electricity for the night.
cards.question: Why does a solar colony need batteries?

cards.title: Solar panel dust brushes
cards.effect: Keeps dust off the solar panels so they give more power.
cards.question: What does Mars dust do to solar panels?

cards.title: Rock lab bench
cards.effect: Lets the crew study the rocks they bring back.
cards.question: What can rocks tell us about water on Mars long ago?
